Reimbursement Overview

$110

Eligible Travel Methods

The following methods of travel are eligible for reimbursement:

### Bus

Public transportation buses

### Plane

Commercial airline flights

### Ride-Sharing

Uber, Lyft, and similar services

### Taxi

Traditional taxi services

### Rental Vehicle

Car rental services

### Personal Vehicle

Gas expenses for your own car

Receipt Requirements

### Required Documentation

- Only the person named on the receipt can be reimbursed
- Verification of initial departure point required
- Digital receipts are accepted for arrival trip only
- Original receipts must be provided at the event

### Important Notes

- Keep all receipts safe until reimbursement is processed
- Each participant must have their own receipt
- Receipts cannot be split among a group

Processing & Timeline

### Processing Time

Reimbursements may take up to 2 months to process after the event.

### How to Submit

Upload your receipts to the reimbursement page by going to the bottom of your profile page and clicking the Submit Reimbursement button.

America’s Startup is a national collegiate startup competition created to spotlight early-stage business ideas with the potential to drive America’s future economic, technological, and societal progress.

# Kelly-Douglas Fund
**Travel Fellowships for IAP and Summer**
## 
**The power of travel**
An important dimension of the Kelly-Douglas Fund is the support for and encouragement of undergraduate education in the humanities, arts and social sciences. We believe that travel outside MIT to pursue an independent project in a HASS field, or to collaborate in a humanitarian project, can have a powerful and lasting effect on students. To this end, a portion of the Fund is reserved for Traveling Fellowships for MIT students pursuing an endeavor of their own devising either during IAP or the Summer.
**Who can apply?**
All MIT sophomores, juniors, and seniors wishing to travel during IAP or Summer are eligible to apply. Students need not belong to the School of HASS, though majors and minors in the School will be given preference.

# The Office of Undergraduate Research and Major Awards

# Undergraduate Research Travel Fellowship
The Office of Undergraduate Research and Major Awards offers the Undergraduate Research
Travel Fellowship to support undergraduate students from the University of Houston
in enhancing their academic development, disseminating their research results, and
increasing the visibility of the institution by supporting undergraduate student travel
at regional, national, and international conferences. The travel funding is intended
for undergraduates presenting the results of their research or creative activities
at meetings for a regional, national, or international audience within their academic
discipline.
**The Undergraduate Research Travel Fellowship application is now closed for the 2024-2025
academic year. Please check back in August for the 2025-2026 URTF application.**
## Funding Offered
Students may apply for up to $500 to cover travel expenses associated with attending
and presenting their research or creative work at a conference.
The Undergraduate Research Travel Fellowship may not cover all expected travel expenses.
Students are strongly encouraged to seek additional funding through research grants,
conference travel award programs, and awards offered by their department

# Student Travel Grants

The IEEE Engineering Medicine and Biology Society (EMBS) is pleased to provide travel grants on a highly competitive basis to EMBS student members to attend EMBC. The grants will be awarded to a limited number of applicants who have a genuine need for support, and the paper quality will be taken into consideration. EMBS student membership is required at the time when the application is made. Find out more information on how to join EMBS.

The grants can only be used to cover the travel expenses for applicants to attend the approved conference. The grants, if approved, will be on a reimbursement basis following instructions given to grantees. The EMBS travel grant selection and oversight committees reserve the right to make the final decision regarding all applications.
